**Goal** to make a react native application just like /frontend using my fastapi endpoints and all that

- Make it in typescript
- Make it look nice, in the same MUI theme as the frontend is right now
- Make it an apk and stuff also

**Requirements**
- Typescript
- React Native
- Axios or Fetch for API calls
- React Navigation for navigation
- Redux or Context API for state management
- MUI (Material-UI) for styling
- React Query for data fetching and caching
- React Hook Form for form handling
- Yup for validation
- React Native Paper for additional UI components
- React Native Reanimated for animations
- React Native Vector Icons for customizable icons
